text: かくとうポケモンを　きたえまくって　はりきって　いどんだのに　ぜんぜん　ダメだった　おまけに…　きが　みじかくて　すぐどなるし　あのバアさん　こわすぎるよ…

structure.jp: かくとうポケモンを　きたえまくって
structure.en: I trained my Fighting Pokémon like crazy and

structure.jp: はりきって　いどんだのに
structure.en: even though I challenged her full of energy

structure.jp: ぜんぜん　ダメだった
structure.en: it was no good at all

structure.jp: きが　みじかくて　すぐどなるし
structure.en: she's short-tempered and quick to yell, and

structure.jp: あのバアさん　こわすぎるよ…
structure.en: that old lady is way too scary...

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling of disappointment at how things turned out. いどんだのに = 'even though I challenged her'.

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word with its い dropped means 'too much'. こわすぎる = 'is too scary'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement means 'and what's more', piling up reasons. すぐどなるし = 'she yells right away, and besides'.
